ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Java Children Processes
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects java process spawning suspicious children

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\/java$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*bash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ksh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*zsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*csh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*fish.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*curl.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wget.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*python.*")))
